name: Summer Internship / Minor Project
description: This course involved students to take up a minor project either in industry or in academic research laboratories in / out of the institution under the mentorship of a faculty from thermal engineering group. The student will be introduced to industry-driven and research-oriented practices. The students carry out their project during the summer after their 1st year and complete the project work with final report submission.
